text_en: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.
text_cn: 保禄和息耳瓦诺及弟茂德，致书给在天主父及主耶稣基督内的得撒洛尼人的教会。祝你们蒙受恩宠与平安！

text_en: We always give thanks to God for all of you and mention you in our prayers, constantly
text_cn: 我们常为你们众人感谢天主，在祈祷时常记念你们；不断地，

text_en: remembering before our God and Father your work of faith and labor of love and steadfastness of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 在天主和我们的父前，记念你们因信德所作的工作，因爱德所受的劳苦，因盼望我们的主耶稣基督所有的坚忍。

text_en: For we know, brothers and sisters beloved by God, that he has chosen you,
text_cn: 天主所爱的弟兄们，我们知道你们是蒙召选的，

text_en: because our message of the gospel came to you not in word only, but also in power and in the Holy Spirit and with full conviction; just as you know what kind of persons we proved to be among you for your sake.
text_cn: 因为我们把福音传到你们那里，不仅在乎言语，而且也在乎德能和圣神，以及坚固的信心；正如你们也知道，我们为了你们，在你们中是怎样为人。

text_en: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord, for in spite of persecution you received the word with joy inspired by the Holy Spirit,
text_cn: 你们虽在许多苦难中，却怀着圣神的喜乐接受了圣道，成了效法我们和效法主的人，

text_en: so that you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and in Achaia.
text_cn: 甚至成了马其顿和阿哈雅众信者的模范。

text_en: For the word of the Lord has sounded forth from you not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place your faith in God has become known, so that we have no need to speak about it.
text_cn: 因为主的圣道由你们那里，不仅声闻于马其顿和阿哈雅，而且你们对天主的信仰也传遍了各地，以致不需要我们再说什么。

text_en: For the people of those regions report about us what kind of welcome we had among you, and how you turned to God from idols, to serve a living and true God,
text_cn: 因为有他们传述我们的事，说我们怎样来到了你们那里，你们怎样离开偶像归依了天主，为事奉永生的真天主，

text_en: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead—Jesus, who rescues us from the wrath that is coming.
text_cn: 并期待他的圣子自天降下，就是他使之从死者中复活，为救我们脱免那要来的震怒的耶稣。
